name: vishvyash-agrotech-erp
description: Production ERP for Vishvyash Agrotech Energy - Biomass Briquettes Manufacturer

scripts.copy:assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('server/public', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('server/public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'server/public', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:server
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed && cd ../client && npm install
